Title: Late Marrow Bay Goal Seals Draw
Body: Halden Forge 3-3 Marrow Bay: the turning point was Stellan Rashid’s 90-minute equaliser, which turned Halden Forge’s 57% possession, 12 shots and 2.86 xG into only a draw. At 10, Viktor Esposito put Halden Forge 1-0 up from Dario Teodor’s assist after Yannick Delacroix won it by tackle in the middle third, the move taking 13 s and carrying 0.41 xG. Marrow Bay levelled at 22 through Umar Strand from Bastian Rautio’s assist, then went 1-2 up at 41 when Noah Fenwick finished another Rautio supply from 21 m. Halden Forge responded at 48, Lorcan Lanzini making it 2-2 from Emre Kowal’s assist, before Kowal himself completed an 8-pass move at 67 to make it 3-2. But at 90, Gideon Okonjo set up Rashid for the 3-3 goal, Marrow Bay’s 10 shots and 2.01 xG proving enough to leave the match level.
